comment: The module has no ports of any kind, so almost everything about it is a Note or a Menu line. Panel lettering reads Send over the button the code wires to PARAM_SEND and Receive over PARAM_RECV (Oscelot.cpp:1004-1012 against res/Oscelot_BlackSteel.svg); the two are the right way round. The three memory buttons and the bank slider carry no lettering. The receiving and sending flags at Oscelot.cpp:73-74 are declared without an initialiser and onReset does not set them, so the state a freshly placed module wakes in is whatever the allocation left; both are stored to and restored from the patch. The four panel themes are left out as cosmetic.
